# LINHAO Toys

> LINHAO Toys is an OEM and ODM manufacturer of custom squishy toys, plush accessories, bag charms and creative gifts for global brands, retailers, distributors and Amazon sellers.

Canonical website: https://linhaotoys.com/
Language: English
Contact: sales@lh-industrial.com

## Product scope

- Custom and wholesale squishy toys
- Glitter and food-shaped squishies
- Mini sensory and blind-box assortments
- Custom plush toys and emotional gifts
- Plush bag charms and retail gift sets
- Private-label product and packaging development

## Buyer information

Product pages state available customization, indicative MOQ, sampling lead time and relevant compliance documentation. Final specifications, testing, MOQ, pricing and production lead time depend on the product, material, packaging and destination market.
